recs.name: Secret Ending
recs.tag: 'No twists along the way at all, it all went smooth.'

lines.x: Utage?
Akafuyu?
I was gonna meet up with Kirara here. You seen her?
What? The girl coming for treatment? You arranged to meet here too?!
Hey, uh, guide?
(Raises head for a glance)
(Lifts phone, points it at the highway scenery)
(Continues tapping on phone)
Ms. Guide—
(Taps on phone screen)
Whaddaya showing me your phone for...
'guide...'
And then a question mark?
You're not the guide who's supposed to show me outta the city?!
(Taps on phone screen)
Then why'd you get in my car? The hell, did the L.G.D. send you?!
(Taps on phone screen)
Quit typing and talk to me!
I thought...
Clearly now!
I thought you were... the driver taking me to Rhodes Island...
'Scuse me, you see a girl dragging this giant case around here?
A girl with a giant case? Can't say I have.
You're an hour late, you only just got here! Of course you haven't seen anything!
Miss, are you talking about a teenaged girl towing a big suitcase, about as tall as you?
Yeah, her! Was she, like, super-absorbed in a hand thingy playing a video game when you saw her?
Can't say as such.
Come again?
She was playing on something that seemed like a game console for a little bit, but then she put it away really fast, and pulled out her phone right after, and she'd just type and then send photos.
Phone?
(Her phone's gonna be from Higashi. Can she use it in Lungmen?)
(Nah, no time to sweat that.)
Should be her, for sure. Do you know where she went?
A car just stopped in front of her a moment ago, and then the driver and her had this look between them, and she took her suitcase and got in. The driver even moved it into the boot for her.
Where's the car headed?
Unbelievable...
My goddamn luck. The guide I book just so happens to be a young Ægir woman in a Higashinese outfit... How the hell does a stumbling block like you come outta the woodwork?!
Um...
If you got something to say, then say it!
I just wanted to ask... why... you thought I was wearing Higashinese clothing?
Huh?
You're garbed up like you walked right outta one of them Higashinese mangos. If that's not the look, what is?
I think you only really look stereotypically Higashinese if you dress like a samurai or a miko or...
Samurai? Miko? Isn't that all just manga stuff? They really got types like that walking around over there?
Uh... never mind.
What are you... driving this... fast for?
Huh? I'm trying to get home!
See, but was gonna meet up with a friend and she was waiting literally where I got in this car... and could you just take me back before you go home?
Fuhgeddaboutit!
Orrr... where do you live? You could go home first and then I'll find a way to get my friend to pick me up...
My home's in Siracusa. That good enough for you?
S-S-Siracusa?!
That's NG, that's totally not happening! I came here all the way from Higashi, I don't have time for a trip to Siracusa too!
Grgh.
See this knife here, ragazza?
Don't tell me you're with... the mafia? The Siracusan mafia?!
Not exactly... but yeah, something like that.
You sit tight and make peace with it. You're my hostage now.
But... you said you missed your guide, so even if you leave Lungmen you still...
Shut it! I ain't giving you no second chance!
That stupid pickpocket didn't just rob a jewelers, he went and nabbed a hostage...
Truly sorry, Miss Akafuyu, that we requested cooperation with Rhodes Island on this investigation and still let this mess happen, and we got your friend involved in it.
Save those words for later! What step are you at in your measures?
We've already sent officers to every expressway and city exit so we can conduct vehicle-to-vehicle inspections...
Clammin' up again? What gives?
(Lifts up handheld device)
You're in the world's nuttiest situation and you still got time to play video games?
(Nods)
You don't got a lick of sense.
What, sick of games now? On your phone again?
...I brought this phone from Higashi.
So?
I can't use a Higashinese phone in Lungmen.
Huh.
Lemme see what you're typing there.
No!
Clam it and give me the phone!
No way! Never ever!
You give me that—
Cazzo, a traffic jam?
Great, perfect. I got my hands free now, ragazza. You give the phone and let me see. If you're not blabbin' to nobody about nothing, we won't have a problem.
I promise you, I'm not doing anything that would be unbeneficial to you!
The hell's a promise do? If promises meant shit, would I have gotten duped all the way out to here?
Just give me the damn phone!
I'm gonna lock it first, okay?
No, you're not—
I think whoever's in the car over has been staring at us!
What?!
Merda!
I'm not typing anymore, I'm putting the phone away, I'm gonna keep playing games, okay?
Okay, you've been going 'ah' every coupla minutes and nothing else. What the hell is it?
I, uh... I've died four or five times on this stage. I... I think I'm tilted.
Am I messing you up here?
No...
(Instinctively pulls out phone)
The hell you think you're up to?!
Sorry—sorry! I just did it automatically!
Huh.
Once I'm back in Siracusa, I'll let you go, and you can text your texts, game your games, nobody'll bother you.
You're seriously going back to Siracusa?
The hell else am I gonna go? Cousin sent me packing to Lungmen like a dumbass, said business here was honey and wine... Whose honey? Ain't no business worth nothing!
I'm telling you, they baited him in, he joined up with a famiglia, and figured he'd get his own little errand boy!

I spent months holding my breath, following him and his business around until I was drowning in all their petty shit. Said I wanted to go home once! Just once! And he robs a jewelry store, pins all the charges on me!
I ain't about to throw away decades a million miles from home!
I got my mamma and papà in Siracusa! They were begging me like crazy before I left, but I was stupider than bricks, and not one word, I didn't listen to one word they said...
I just wanna go home, wanna see them! One more time! And if the powers that be say I'm a coward and decide to sink me into a river, then that's the price I gotta pay!
(Habitually pulls out phone and begins typing)
(Quietly) Honestly... I don't wanna be away from home either.
(Quietly) I went through a lot of my own pain getting out here, all the way from home...
Come again?
Nothing.
You don't have a guide, though, even... Are you really gonna make it back to Siracusa?
Whaddaya want me to do? Ask the L.G.D.?
Sure, I got duped, but I'm still a mafioso. What, a suit walking right up to the fuzz? Saying 'I got set up?' You think they'll listen?
If they don't wanna listen to you, then it doesn't matter how much you tell them, they're just gonna go by their preconceptions so they can misinterpret whatever you say. I know that.
Okay, see, I thought you were just gonna risk your life begging me to 'explain the situation' to an L.G.D.
But, uh, even if you can't convince them, you're probably not gonna die... On the other hand, if you run into trouble in the wasteland then you're definitely never making it back.
Hold on.
Huh?
Hold on, that—is that an L.G.D. roadblock?! Are they checking cars?!
Hey, and I see you pulled out your phone again, huh?!
You were sending the L.G.D. a nice little tip-off after all! Gimme that damned thing—
Cease!
Kirara, get out of the car now! We're Rhodes Island operators, we're here for you!
God damned L.G.D. laphounds!
Kirara, grab my hand—
What is it? Why are you frozen? This is an urgent situation; whatever it is, you can save it for later!
But—
Relax, Kirara, I got your collection out the trunk already. You get out of the car with Akafuyu. L.G.D.'ll take care of the perp!
Utage?!
A—Alright!
(Sighs)
Okay, guy kinda gave us the runaround, but you're alright, the luggage you were protecting the whole way's fine, it's all good. Medetashi, medetashi.
Kirara, hello?
I know you're in shock, but, like, you're gonna block traffic if you keep standing there, okay?
Oh! Sorry...
You got your fruit tea, you've tried Lungmen's famous finballs. I bet you feel calmer now, right, girl?
Um... mmhm. Thanks, Utage.
Lemme get you introduced. This real samurai-vibey lady's Rhodes Island Operator Akafuyu. Should've been her sitting in the car, actually, with the robber guy.
Why?
She's the whole 'guide' he was talking about.
The... young Higashinese-dressed Ægir woman... he was looking for... was her?
Indeed. The L.G.D. has been following him, but scared of alarming him, they had me act the guide, so he could be seized at an opportune moment.
Who knew I'd be so careless, and even draw you in, Kirara. I am truly sorry to startle you.
It's... alr...
(Habitually fishes out phone)
Huh?
(Alarmedly rummages for phone)
It's not polite to send your thanks via text if they're right in front of you, girl.
N—No... I left my phone in that car!
Chill, we'll pick out a new one for you in a bit. Call it a little get-well-soon.
But I've got a lot of important stuff on that phone, and I mean really, honestly important stuff!
You got, like, game cheat codes on there? Or some kinda training notes so you can beat the super tough guys?
Okay... yes, both of those are in there but I don't mean them!
Utage, can we follow that car?
Akafuyu?
This pursuit is in the L.G.D.'s hands now. If we give further chase, I fear we'll simply make trouble for them.
She looks anxious for real to me.
I know her, and I don't think losing her entire collection forever in that car would, like, get to her as bad as this.
Right, Kirara?
(Fiercely nods)
If so, it's not as if we can't send word to the L.G.D. Where should we look for him, however, given he raced away from the checkpoint?
That's—no worries, I can handle that...
You go, Kirara. What, you can pin your phone's location on your handheld or?
Actually, I modded all my electronics before I left so I could protect against losing anything, so they've all got relative tracking functions to each other...
Whoa, you got even crazier at modding tech stuff and I never knew!
Anyhow, that red point that's been moving the whole time is my phone's position, so it looks like that guy hasn't realized I left it in his car yet...
Given so, we have an easy in.
Utage, your classmate here is by no means of ordinary ability.
Preach it. All of my friends are showstoppers. I know that best.
Haha...
Straight for five hundred meters and then take the next right.
The way you've been, like, looking at the map on your console and then giving directions, it's kinda like you're playing a game.
No, that's not really what's going on, I'm just... just looking at a map.
This is no time for modesty, girl.
...resisting...
...give yourself up...
No mistake. We've made dead heat on the target!
Stop resisting! Lay your weapons down, put your hands up and come out!
I don't want none—none of you near me!
Let me go, I wanna leave Lungmen, I'm going back to Siracusa, I wanna go home!
Let it go! Now lay your weapons down, and we can still approach you with an open mind!
Like hell! I know what you're gonna do to me—I ain't no fool! I'm going home, dammit, I just need to get out of here and back to Siracusa!
First that stupid cousin, then the 'famiglia,' and now you, and that girl just earlier, you're all out for blood! You're all filthy liars!
I want you all gone! Get out of my goddamn way! You're not fooling me no more! I'm going home!
Shoot, I think he snapped.
This is kind of a stalemate, so the L.G.D. are gonna go to force soon. I don't think we can guarantee your phone'll survive a firefight, and that guy is, like, the world vs. him at this point.
Akafuyu, you think we can slip in?
Absolutely not. The L.G.D. cannot ensure our safety should we intrude over the cordon. We can only pray the man calms down soon.
I did ask the L.G.D. His jewelry store robbery had no casualties, which should mean they take him into custody.
Ugh, yeah, custody beats dying any day. So when's he gonna realize it, again?
But he... said he was framed.
Huh?!
While we were in the car he told me, he didn't actually rob that store, he was set up by somebody else.
Did he actually, factually say that?
Yeah...
Akafuyu, could you tell that to an L.G.D. guy for us, please?
I could, no issue, but the L.G.D. wouldn't let him walk on a single person's testimony.
Still better than watching everyone fry right now! Go!
Understood!
Maybe they'll change up their gameplan once they find out. Fingers crossed.
Let's get outta here for now, Kirara. I mean, you can tell, but we're just counting on other people at this point.
Final warning! Drop your weapons!
If you still refuse to comply with the law, we will authorize the use of force!
Damn you all to hell! I get it, you just wanted me here all along so you could take my life!
I'll count to ten! If you won't give yourself up before then, we WILL use force!
One...
Shoot, I don't think she's gonna make it. Hey, Kirara, you might wanna prep mentally to...
Kirara? What are you doing?
Kirara has her handheld up, and her finger is dancing all across the screen.
That's... not the console's interface, that's, like, beyond it. You made that? You're sending instructions from your own interface?
Two...
Three...
Four...
Are you trying to dial yourself from your console? You wanna get talking with him?
It's just... a wake-up call.
Please, please...
Nine...
Ten!
We are authorizing the use of force, all positions—
Target sighted, no weapons on person!
Target is stripped of all arms...
Your hospitalization procedures are all in order, Miss Kirara.
(Taps on phone screen)
'thanks'?
No problem!
Kirara, come on, didn't I tell you? It's so rude to type when you're literally, like, face to face!
So... rry.
Eh, no big. I know it was more than a day or two that got you like this.
C'mon, lemme show you where you're living!
Seriously, that night? Everything hanging in the balance? I thought he was gonna die.
Honestly, after all that and the shock you went through, you're incredible. I can't believe you testified for him anyway.
So, did they pass his verdict yet?
Doesn't happen that fast, girl.

But I heard Akafuyu say the L.G.D. finished their investigation and figured out it wasn't actually him who held up the jewelry store. Now he's got charges for obstructing public duty and... something, whatever it was? I don't remember.
Considering he also kinda got baited into the mafia too, he'll probably get a year and a half and then deported out.
Which, like, it only panned out this way thanks to you.
All I did was make him notice my phone, and that was it.
He saw what was on there and realized I wasn't lying to him while I was in the car. Wasn't more than that.
Seriously? Sooo what kinda spell did you put in your phone to make a hard-boiled guy like that give himself up?
It wasn't a spell or anything, just some super normal stuff.
You sure?
Of course I'm sure!
So normal, you won't even let me see?
You seriously don't need to, I'm not kidding!
Hmm...
Not gonna push you, then.
Bye-bye, Kirara. Get some sleep if you're worn out, okay?
It's not a spell or incantation or anything, it's just...
Just some stuff I need to copy and mail out.
Kirara fishes out her phone, and scrolls the whole way down her drafts, until she hits the day she set out.
Since leaving that nomadic city she called home, her phone's mail service has been out of commission.
But leaving home for the first time, the girl still records everything she sees, hears, feels and thinks, no matter how big or small, in her drafts folder.
Kirara pulls a sheet of letter paper from her drawer, and copies from her drafts, going character by character, by word, by sentence.
A folder filled both with great chunks of text, and messy fragments of phrases.

lines.st: 'day 2. completely out of nomadic city signal range today, no more using phone to stay in touch anymore. dont worry though, once im at rhodes island like utage says, ill send you all a million letters.'
'day 5. sat in a car the whole day. insanely bumpy over the wasteland, couldnt even play my handheld the whole way or else id throw up.'

'day 11. in yan now, road suddenly got way better! plants look kind of like home here but also kind of not, could only vaguely tell, i dont know plants much anyway. driver switched to someone yanese too, looks really tough but actually kind of chill, gave me some snacks apparently specialty of yan. wonder if theres a lot of yanese people at rhodes island?'

lines.x: Kirara devotedly copies, filling page after letter page, until she reaches the draft dated latest.

lines.st: 'day 34. finally in lungmen! agreed to meet utage in the city tonight, but she said something came up and she couldnt make it and someone else would meet up with me. she likes joking a lot though so maybe shell actually show up.

'waited on an empty stomach the whole day until the guy whos meeting me finally showed up. seems kind of unapproachable. hope its not all guys like him at rhodes island or else im never gonna be able to say a word.
'i think i got in the wrong car. drivers not rhodes island, hes siracusan mafia. he says hes going to go back to siracusa what do i do
'he got framed from the start, he just wants to go home.
'i want to go home too.
'i miss home.

'ive been missing home the whole time actually, i just held it in and never wrote about it before. everythings really nice in yan, but the food keeps being different everywhere and i cant get used to it, i always get stomach aches, i cant use my phone i cant send mail i cant chat with my friends i dont even have the guts to talk to anyone its horrible, the wind is really harsh in the wastes and sand got in my eyes nobody even helped me i just had to get it out with a napkin myself
'mom dad i miss you

'if i make it out of here alive and if my oripathy gets stable when rhodes island is in higashi i promise ill come back to see you i promise ill be a cheerful happy person i wont worry you anymore i promise'

lines.x: The draft abruptly ends there.
Kirara tears up the sheet that contains this draft, crumples it into a ball, and throws it on the floor.
She locks her phone screen, and on a fresh sheet of paper writes anew, 'day 34'.

lines.st: 'day 34. finally in lungmen! me and utage met up in the city, utage took me to rhodes island. no twists along the way at all, it all went smooth.
'i love you.'

lines.x: How are they?
That leader girl got slashed from behind by the bandits. Still out for the moment.
That many, all sneaking up on one woman at once. Cowards!
S—So what now?
What do you mean what now? Those thieves were after our medicine, so they want us dead!
I'll take them on if it comes to that, my life against theirs! I can use Arts myself...
They live by getting one over! We couldn't even light a flame if we wanted. Taking them on would never get anywhere...
Even if it wouldn't, we've got to! You saying you want those bloodthirsty cutthroats to make off with our medicine, after we barely managed to buy it?

All our efforts just to buy this one cheap measly lot of suppressants! And I want you to imagine, if it wasn't for them, then you, me, the village at large, how long we'll still be alive for all these damn stones in us!
Not to mention, there's Rhodes Islanders with us...
But Rhodes is only here to deliver the drugs!
You get it straight. Once they put the drugs in our hands, they could go at any time. They wouldn't help us!
And even if they did stay... You've seen how badly the leader got hurt, after how easily she dealt with the beasts. Now it's just those girls left—what do you think they're going to be able to do?
The bandits aren't going to just forgive and forget after failing to steal our drugs. They might attack again at any moment!
Better we give them whatever they want. Better than dooming us all. We—We can always figure out something else!
Think carefully about this Rhodes Island or whatever. With how cheap they're selling it, who knows if the drugs are real or fake...
Enough! You can shut up any day!
Erk.
I didn't hear this lousy tune from you when those girls helped us fend off the beasts AFTER dropping off the medicine, or when that doctor girl gave you an examination!
You think the measly amount we forked over was worth them delivering it all the way out here, and bringing a doctor to do checkups free of charge?
If that's the lengths Rhodes Island will go to, then whether or not the medicine works, I'm still believing in them!
Tell me, then... You think we can actually protect these drugs?
We can only try.
Now, enough. I'm going to help the Rhodes Islanders. You find something to busy yourself with.
Fine. One of the girls asked me to help out this morning. Still a little work left to go. I'll fetch somebody else to come with.
(Not good. This is totally not good, the way things are going.)
(Captain's KO'd and hurt, treatment takes time, now all we've got is a DPS and also me, a weird support character without many use cases...)
(Wait, no, nononobad. This is a really serious situation, I can't talk about it like a game.)
(But... I mean, this is hard. This is a tough one...)
*sigh*
What's the sigh for?
Wgaagh!
Phew, uh, okay, it's you, Utage...
In the flesh.
(Please don't pop up behind me without warning like that, you're going to jumpscare me to death.)
(What are you, a ninja or something?)
Did I spook you? Soz.
Come on, though, I'm not some kinda ninja.
Wha? Huh?
(How did she know what I was thinking...?)
(It couldn't be... mindreading?!)
I don't have superpowers or anything, you're just, like, real easy to read, girl.
(You're kidding me. Can you really tell?)
Yeah, for real real.
(Well, that's convenient, now I don't need to talk.)
Hey, slow down, Kirara.
It's not a conversation unless you say what you're thinking out loud.
Or, like, what, do you want me to just stare at you forever? Hmm?
Okay, joke's over.
I'm gonna go check up on Akafuyu. See ya in a bit~
Uh...
Hold on, Utage!
Hm?
I'm coming with you.
So, uh, Utage... what do you think about the situation we're in right now?
Um... pretty messed up, I guess.
We were expecting a normal delivery mission, right? So, not like we prepared that much.
We did get a team put together...
Buuut the captain was our big hitter, and she left a whole opening to get backstabbed in.
Haaa...
I have no laughs in me right now.
Usually, average bandits aren't, like, a match for us at all, but they've got way too many guys. Kind of out of my league, if I had to solo them.
Our doctor's not gonna do combat, and you...
Don't look at me, I'm a Logistics techie.
Oh, word? I always feel like every tech I know's pretty good in a fight.
Besides, you were good at those strategy games, weren't you? And you and the Doctor broke some kinda record one time? So, like, maybe being a commander's your thing.
What do you think? Wanna try?
Me?
You're joking, real life isn't a video game, I... I can't.
We should probably go see how Akafuyu's doing.
Aww... it's a bad habit to casually shoot yourself down.
Besides, you've totally got ideas going, don't you?
So hard to be honest, Kirara.
The wound won't pose much issue, and we've applied anti-inflammatory.
She still hasn't come around, but as long as she's not got a fever, then she should be out of the woods after convalescing properly.
Oh, okay...
That's great to hear.
But, like, how much longer is our captain gonna sleep for?
That's up to Akafuyu's own constitution. We've given her all the treatment we can, but the wound was very deep...
Even if she does wake up, she can't return to combat straight away.
Hmm? We can't just wave her in anyway?
No!
*sigh*...
The sensors I laid out indicate those bandits have been in the area the whole time. We did get in touch with a nearby squad, but it's still gonna be a while before they get here.
If the bandits attack now, while the time is ripe, I think we might...
Might be done for.
So now what? You think we take the captain and retreat?
Wait, if we go, what about the Infected here?
We've delivered the medication, so that's mission complete, but I can't just leave the villagers for dead.
Hmm... we take the medication too?
Okay, putting aside whether or not they'd buy that as a ruse, I think the bandits are after more than the meds anyway. They can fight the people here, and they have literally no way to fight back.
That's true...
So, uh...
Actually, I think we could—
Excuse me, I've brought you all some food...
A little place like ours doesn't have much, so if you can just put up with it.
Thank you, it's kind to worry about us. Was anyone from the village hurt in the previous attack?
We're all fine, thanks to your group.
Can I ask how your captain's doing?
No worries, she's not in danger now.
Oh, okay, that's a massive relief!
Right, can't forget this too.
It's those topographic maps of the place you all wanted...
Huh? Topographic maps? I didn't hear anything about that.
I didn't request any either... Did Akafuyu ask for them at some point?
...It was me.
Thanks.
The voice of gratitude is near-inaudible.
Silent since the villager entered the room, the girl seems in a rush to dodge all lines of sight, dropping her gaze to the maps she now holds.
Being hand-drawn by the Infected of the wild settlement, they are rough and crude, no more than a few abstract lines drawn as hints in parts; they could hardly amount to real topographies.
Absorbing correct information from maps like these would be far from easy.
But grasping them tight, the Higashinese girl comes off like a truly experienced hand, rapidly flipping through the sheets.
Mmhuh...
(Majorly flat terrain, very disadvantageous to us.)
(But there's places here to exploit for sure... like here. If we can do a little setup here...)
(The plan works, it's feasible. But...)
So? Did you work something out?
Attagirl, Kirara~ Look at you, you got something brewing in your head, don't you?
What?! Really? Girl, you... no! Miss, you have an idea?!
...I think we...
Uh...
What did she even wanna say? She was just stammering. Say something or get off.
Just wasting time... You can't even hear how quiet she talks!

I know, right? I heard in seventh grade, she was absent, uh, so much she almost repeated. She never showed up to class. Everyone thought she did something to make the school suspend her, like literally, everyone.
*snort* Apparently she likes those little plastic figures too. What if she was just secretly doing something, like, gross at home? Wow... creepy.

And her name totally doesn't fit, right? Like, you know you see it and you think Kirara, like she's gonna be this sparkly kinda pretty girl? But actually, she's just Kirara the weird downcast depresso. Such a buzzkill.
Her face? She never even lifts her head, who knows what her face is like...?
Kirara, the school has resolved that we can't tolerate you being absent from class again like last year.
If you can't adapt to school life, we may have to consider getting in touch with your parents about you repeating a year, or even withdrawing from school entirely...

lines.st: ...Stop looking.
Stop looking at me.
Stop looking at me like that.

lines.x: No...
I, I d... I don't know...
(I can't breathe...)
(What am I doing? Just say your words, come on, you're not at school here...)
Uh, ah... I'd like to suggest—
B—Bad news!!
The bandits! The bandits are back! They're surrounding the entrance, they've hurt some of us too...
What?!
There's wounded? Where? I need you to take me there immediately!
Guess that's that. I'm coming too.
Hey, Kirara.
Don't keep us waiting too long.
(Freaking Utage talking, it's like she understands everything.)
(What's the deal? I haven't figured this out myself yet...)
(No, I can't just stand here like an idiot, I've got to do something or other and it's simple as that!)
Urgh...
Eek!
Don't make such a fuss.
Ssss... owowow, I can feel my wound.
Akafuyu?! You're up?!
How's your wound, are you okay? D-D-D-Don't move! Quick, lie down!
Just lie back down, I'll call for Honeyberry right away—
Come back, you needn't call anyone!
I can hold on... I actually awoke quite a time ago, and I heard everything you talked about. No great issues press me—my body simply wouldn't heed me somewhat.
If the bandits that assaulted me have delivered themselves to me, then good! Watch me cut them down!
Ourgh!
Tsss...
No, okay, great issues are extremely pressing you!
Quit moving! Aaaahh okay okay your wound's bleeding again... Stay still, put the katana down!

You're in no condition to fight right now, at all, whatsoever! You think you're some kinda fighting game protag? As long as your health bar's not empty yet you're completely unaffected, is that it, huh??
Tch... There, you can talk quite fine, can't you.
What do we do, then? If I cannot go, I fear Utage will buckle before long.
Are you saying you have some plan?
I—I've come up with it, kind of, but...
I don't think I can do it...
Fool. What is it you're so afraid of?
What? I'm not...
You are.
Out with your ideas! I will judge as the captain whether or not they work!
On what basis do you say you can't do it? These squad members were handpicked by me. Are you saying I could not discern properly?
Wait, wait, I didn't I wasn't... You're twisting my words against me!
Yes, indeed. What is it? If you have objections, speak and let me hear.
(Nnnnrgghh—)
(What the hell is her deal—!)
I see you as quite the strategizer. I've never bested you once in that regard!
But those were games...
Split no hairs. I recall you also discussed tactical command with that Doctor at one point?
But that was on the topic of games too!
And they've taught you plenty applicable in practice, no?!
Enough tarrying! Eyes wide! It's simple as this: will you do it?
I've told you that I am the one who will judge here! I am your general in this moment, and you are my counsel. Now hasten in offering your advice!
Huff... hah...
What... even... stammering...
......hear how quiet...
...absent......did something...
...likes those......secretly...
...totally doesn't fit......weird downcast... buzzkill...
...who knows... like...
...school has resolved...
If...

lines.st: Shut up.
Oh my god shut up.
I don't care what people say, I don't give a care...
Yeah. Yeah, okay. Didn't I already decide?

lines.x: (Deep breath)
I'll talk, I'll freaking talk okay?! Stop making this scene such a big emotional deal, does it seriously not embarrass you when everything starts hitting you like lines from a visual novel?!
I'll say it, I'm totally gonna say it!
I think we can—
Someone else is hurt! Please get the wounded over to me, faster!
Sorry, but I can't hold them off for too long either. We're gonna get surrounded like this.
Seriously, are our drugs worth this much?
Compared to other medications on the market, we sell really cheap... and the efficacy's guaranteed.
Oh, so that's why we send a whole squad on deliveries all the time.
Yes...
It's not just an issue of money. Medications like these are difficult to buy on the market period, so...
That's why there's Infected among the people robbing too.
Yes.
Isn't there anything we can do...?
O—Oh, right! That pink-haired girl had me set up a machine earlier! Is there something we can do with that?
Machine?
I didn't hear anything about that.
Me neither.
I think I'm getting deja vu.
But...!
Oh, if you wanna know about that...
Why don't we just make her explain it herself?
Right, that's the Miss who asked us to do everything!
(Phew... it's okay, I can do this, I can speak, it's okay...)
—Everyone, listen to me!
I have a plan.
*pant*... *pant*...
Found her! Over here!
She's got all the drugs in her car! After her!
(...hah, they followed.)
(If the map was right, then around here there should be...)
(No, wait!)
(I have to go further north!)
(Phew...)
(Yep, okay, this is the area, this is some loose sand alright...!)
(We make the sand subside here, and form quicksand...)
(Great!)
(Thank you, Originium Arts. I think I could kinda fill a mage role like this, huh?)
(Done! Next. I just stall for time a little...)
(Need to find a place to hide myself.)
Where'd she go?
Where's she hiding? The car's still here. Get all the drugs out!
Hey, girl, can you hear me?!
Ran out with the goods all alone, huh? Thought you could get away on a fluke, or are you just trying to lure us out?
No matter your plan, it's nothing now!
(What's the deal with this guy? He's a trash-talker.)
(Oh, if only I could tell him how every character who talks too much before a battle usually comes out of it pretty bad.)
Hey! The med boxes here... they're all empty!
We got tricked!
Heh... expected that. Looks like she just wanted to string us along.
Shame for you, though. You can pretend you're on your solo adventure, but we're not as stupid as you think.
You know how many of us chased your bait? Less than half.
The rest of us probably broke through that lousy Infected village by now, I'm reckoning?
Uh... wow, you really can talk.
Honestly, I'm kind of starting to envy the sheer confidence you've gotta have in order to talk at your opponent like you're straight up giving a speech.
Oh? Who knew that's where you'd be hiding... What, not gonna run?
Don't care to, anymore.
Is it really going to work?
This is all we've got. If, just if, it doesn't do anything...
What's to fear?! You heard Kirara's plan yourselves! The feasibility is tremendous!
And lest we forget, I'm present too! A wounded general is hardly a rare sight... *hiss*
Stop showing off, Akafuyu!
Kirara already led a bunch of the guys away. The numbers on the rest...
Mmhm, I think I should basically make it, even if we have issues.
There you have it.
I estimate she saw this too, hence why her arrangements are so?
Okay, then, no time to lose.
Everyone ready? Push the switch... 'eyy!
What... What is that?!
That's a caster's Arts! Hey, are you suicidal? Pull out!
Where did they find so many casters...?
Urgh!!
Watch out, girl. Arts aren't the only danger on the scene.
What the hell kind of trick are you pulling?!
We've been watching the whole time! There's no way you found a caster to help—
Hm? Didn'tcha know? Infected can use Arts barehanded.
You back these guys into a corner, and they can seriously do anything. You get me?
Oh, heyyy, lucky, everyone's actually Infected here.
Guess how many'd rather burst into dust in your face than let you get your way, huh?
Maniacs!
These Infected are all insane! They're going to take us down with them!
Run for it!!
The bandits! They're beginning to retreat!
Really?! Oh, thank heavens...!
Who knew this little box could be so much of a threat?
Good skies, didn't that work a little too well?
H—Honestly!
When we pressed it and the sound of Arts firing suddenly went off all around, even I was jumpy!
Using a preconstructed projector to intimidate the enemy! Trust her to think of it...
And arranged so perfectly in such a short span of time. How did she possibly do it?
Er, the pink-haired Miss asked us to install all these machines this morning.
Pardon? This morning?
Wait, when we'd just become aware of the bandits, before anything had even happened?!
What in the stances did the Doctor teach her...?
Aaaand it's time.
What did you do?!
This pit... pteuch, she's trapping us!
Help me! I'm going to get buried!
Girl! Don't you care if they live or die?!
Even if you kill us all, the village is still—
You just keep going...
What I want is a perfect clear.
Huh?
You wouldn't just ignore bait as obvious as me. Even if you didn't totally buy it, you'd at least send part of your people to follow, and that was enough.
We trap a portion using me, a support who doesn't affect the big picture, which lowers your numbers, and back in the village we've got Utage for high attack, so they're pretty sure to handle it.
Not to mention the projectors...
Wait, why am I explaining all this to you again?
Explaining your own plan is what antags do, and then they mess it up and they get comeback'd on. NG, NG.
What the hell kind of craziness are you talking to yourself about?
You have a bind debuff, you don't get to interrupt!
Hiii, Kirara, can you hear me~
Oi, Utage! No nonsense from you!
Kirara, well done! We sorted things out handily on this side. How was yours?
Kirara, you're not hurt, are you?
...Heheh.
No, I'm fine, I'm untouched. All good on my end too.
Ahem.
...Just as planned.
